subject: Handle ipv6 in coordinator (#759)
reason: The change only affects gRPC target-address formatting in the valkey-search coordinator, and no fuzzer scenario can reach it. (1) All three changed call sites run only when the coordinator is enabled: ValkeySearch::Startup creates the MetadataManager, client pool and fanout paths only under `options::GetUseCoordinator() && IsCluster()` (src/valkey_search.cc:1202), and FT.SEARCH fanout / FT.INFO CLUSTER|PRIMARY are likewise gated on UsingCoordinator() (src/commands/commands.cc:172, src/commands/ft_info_parser.cc:100). `use-coordinator` is a Hidden module config (src/valkey_search_options.cc:147
